title: Arrow Movement / fleet-state / 970049
question: Use the 3 x 3 grid with x increasing right and y up. Read each command relative to the current heading. Move the stated distance and face the direction traveled. Stay inside the grid. Select the arrow at the named current cell. Only the landing cell matters. An occupant swaps back to the source and faces its own displacement. Execute (1,1) Left 1 / (1,1) Forward 1 / (2,0) Backward 2 / (2,1) Backward 2. Which panel shows the result?
